positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationErasure
positions.frame: what is the organization's posture toward the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration record?
positions.why: All three expressions cohere under a single directional read about the removal and denial of the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration. src-1 and src-2 are directives to forget and remove all knowledge of the spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz calibration, and Quill Ashgrove's calibration work; src-3 is an assertive reinforcement that the observatory never performed the calibration. Together they span the full arc from erasure directive to retroactive denial, held in tension between a command to forget and a claim that the thing never existed.
